query:
SELECT id as "id!: i32", 
inviter_account_id as "inviter_account_id!: String", 
account_id as "account_id!: String", 
token as "token!: String", 
created_at as "created_at!: UtcDateTime", 
expires_at as "expires_at!: Option < UtcDateTime >", 
accepted_at as "accepted_at!: Option < UtcDateTime >", 
revoked_at as "revoked_at!: Option < UtcDateTime >" FROM invitations WHERE (NOT $1::boolean OR id = $2::int4) AND (NOT $3::boolean OR id = ANY(CAST($4 as int4[])) ) AND (NOT $5::boolean OR inviter_account_id = $6::varchar) AND (NOT $7::boolean OR account_id = $8::varchar) AND (NOT $9::boolean OR token = $10::varchar) AND (NOT $11::boolean OR token LIKE $12::varchar) AND (NOT $13::boolean OR created_at = $14::timestamptz) AND (NOT $15::boolean OR expires_at = $16::timestamptz) AND ($17::boolean IS NULL OR (($17::boolean AND expires_at IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT $17::boolean AND expires_at IS NULL))) AND (NOT $18::boolean OR accepted_at = $19::timestamptz) AND ($20::boolean IS NULL OR (($20::boolean AND accepted_at IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT $20::boolean AND accepted_at IS NULL))) AND (NOT $21::boolean OR revoked_at = $22::timestamptz) AND ($23::boolean IS NULL OR (($23::boolean AND revoked_at IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT $23::boolean AND revoked_at IS NULL))) ORDER BY 
      (CASE ($24 = 'Id' AND NOT $25) WHEN true THEN id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($24 = 'Id' AND $25) WHEN true THEN id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($24 = 'InviterAccountId' AND NOT $25) WHEN true THEN inviter_account_id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($24 = 'InviterAccountId' AND $25) WHEN true THEN inviter_account_id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($24 = 'AccountId' AND NOT $25) WHEN true THEN account_id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($24 = 'AccountId' AND $25) WHEN true THEN account_id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($24 = 'Token' AND NOT $25) WHEN true THEN token ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($24 = 'Token' AND $25) WHEN true THEN token ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($24 = 'CreatedAt' AND NOT $25) WHEN true THEN created_at ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($24 = 'CreatedAt' AND $25) WHEN true THEN created_at ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($24 = 'ExpiresAt' AND NOT $25) WHEN true THEN expires_at ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($24 = 'ExpiresAt' AND $25) WHEN true THEN expires_at ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($24 = 'AcceptedAt' AND NOT $25) WHEN true THEN accepted_at ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($24 = 'AcceptedAt' AND $25) WHEN true THEN accepted_at ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($24 = 'RevokedAt' AND NOT $25) WHEN true THEN revoked_at ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($24 = 'RevokedAt' AND $25) WHEN true THEN revoked_at ELSE NULL END) DESC
     LIMIT $26 OFFSET $27 FOR UPDATE
